```{python}
import os
import polars as pl

base_dir = r"\\smb\ra266580\Documentos\ME315"

basics_path = os.path.join(base_dir, "title.basics0.tsv.gz")
ratings_path = os.path.join(base_dir, "title.ratings.tsv.gz")
principals_path = os.path.join(base_dir, "title.principals0.tsv.gz")

basics_lazy = pl.scan_csv(basics_path, separator="\t", null_values=r"\N").select(["tconst", "titleType", "primaryTitle", "genres"])
ratings_lazy = pl.scan_csv(ratings_path, separator="\t", null_values=r"\N").select(["tconst", "averageRating", "numVotes"])
principals_lazy = pl.scan_csv(principals_path, separator="\t", null_values=r"\N").select(["tconst", "nconst", "category"])
```

## 1

```{python}
q1 = (
  basics_lazy.filter(pl.col("titleType") == "movie")
  .join(ratings_lazy, on="tconst")
  .sort(["averageRating", "numVotes"], descending=[True, True])
  .select(["primaryTitle", "averageRating", "numVotes"])
  .limit(5)
  .collect()
)

print(q1)
```

## 2

```{python}
q2 = (
    basics_lazy.filter(pl.col("titleType") == "movie")
    .join(ratings_lazy, on="tconst")
    .filter(pl.col("averageRating") > 8)
    .with_columns(pl.col("genres").str.split(","))
    .explode("genres")
    .filter(pl.col("genres").is_not_null())
    .group_by("genres")
    .len()
    .sort("len", descending=True)
    .limit(1)
    .collect()
)

print(q2)
```

## 3

```{python}
principals_atores = principals_lazy.filter(
    pl.col("category").is_in(["actor", "actress"])
)

q3 = (
    basics_lazy.filter(pl.col("titleType") == "movie")
    .join(ratings_lazy, on="tconst")
    .filter(pl.col("averageRating") > 7.5)
    .join(principals_atores, on="tconst")
    .group_by("nconst")
    .len()
    .sort("len", descending=True)
    .limit(3)
    .collect()
)

print(q3)
```
